_note: THE MEET-UP: a new board family, his idea. The job is turning up; the story is who is there and what they want. Talks at a placed person are built, so most letters need nothing new.
Voices borrowed until his ear casts them. No names, places or currency in any voiced line.

LETTER e: THE INTERVIEW: a crew lead who hires only people she has met. The player's prompts are the questions; her answers tell him more about her than his tell her. The ending is a promise of work on the board (EVE's breadcrumb, unbuilt, so it stays a promise).

FRANCES 2026-10-31 (reviews/2026-10-31-delve-MB93e.md): rework, findings 1-5 taken, 6 kept. Forced pick answered YES: it is the same named crew lead every draw, so she says she meets people more than once, and the close is her verdict and her reason.

place._theme: Any built site where two people could arrange to meet: no caves, no natural landmarks.

prose.name: Requisition: A Crew Lead Wants to Meet
prose.briefing: A crew lead at the <Place> hires contractors she has met in person, and has paid for a meeting.
prose.card: Private Contract. A crew lead at the <Place> on <Planet> wants to meet a contractor before hiring. Payment on completion.

beats.objective: Meet the crew lead at the <Place>
beats.journal: The crew lead met me, answered my questions, and said she'd put work on the board with my name on it.
greeting: You came. I hire for a crew that doesn't advertise, so I meet people first, and I meet them more than once. Ask me anything, and then I'll decide.

exchanges.prompt: I've heard enough. When do I start?
reply: When something goes on the board with your name on it. You never asked about the money. I noticed.

exchanges.prompt: Crews that don't advertise usually have a reason.
reply: We do. Mostly that we're good, and the good ones don't need to.
Fetching. Things people need from places they can't go. I did it alone for six years before I had a crew, and I'd rather not again.
Because a name on a board tells me nothing, and five minutes at a table tells me most of it.

beats._talk: Exchange 0 ends it and pays. The promise of board work is a promise only: the breadcrumb is unbuilt.
